links.comparator_used: Aggregate cross-population AUC reported across all patients, versus within-stratum AUCs
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) in external validation, aggregate versus within-stratum
links.effect: Simpson's paradox gap of 5.0–16.5 pp across the eight cross-population runs; worst case aggregate AUC 0.756 vs within-stratum AUCs 0.58–0.60
links.quote: Across the eight cross-population runs, aggregate AUCs concealed substantially lower within-stratum AUCs (Simpson’s paradox gap range 5.0–16.5 pp; worst case: aggregate AUC 0.756 vs within-stratum AUCs 0.58–0.60).

design_hint: local recalibration (Platt scaling) and bidirectional external validation before deployment
